import torch.nn as nn

class XORModel(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        self.linear1 = nn.Linear(2, 4)
        self.relu = nn.ReLU()
        self.linear2 = nn.Linear(4, 1)

    def forward(self, x):
        x = self.linear1(x)
        x = self.relu(x)
        x = self.linear2(x)
        return x
